goal: Refresh the Master Data route after Foundation setup routes were parked, without opening Business Central or changing data.
whyNow: The Foundation setup package/manual UI routes are parked. The project should avoid another weak Foundation retry and instead convert existing customer/vendor/item evidence into training, handbook, data-route and setup-gap decisions without claiming setup or process readiness.
businessPurpose: Keep concrete project progress moving while preserving the Foundation no-write boundary.
expectedOutput: A compact local decision that states which customer/vendor/item training, handbook or data-route work can continue while Foundation setup stays parked.
A nextCase selection that does not write setup, master data, documents, Preview Posting or Posting.
Explicit boundary that existing read-first Master Data evidence is training/handbook input, not setup-ready or process-ready proof.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision would require opening Business Central or running Playwright.
Stop if the next step would create, edit or claim readiness for customer, vendor or item data.
Stop if the output weakens the parked Foundation setup boundary.
Stop if a book claim would be written without a separate book case.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use if existing customer/vendor/item evidence can be turned into training or handbook structure without book text edits.
Use only if a future read-first UI proof is needed and live gates explicitly allow it.
Use if no safe Master Data training/handbook progress is possible without resolving setup first.
